gaps.sentence: There's no point ___ about it now.
gaps.explanation: there's no point + -ing: no point worrying.

gaps.sentence: I could hear the neighbours ___ again last night.
gaps.explanation: hear + object + -ing = hear an action in progress: hear them arguing.

gaps.sentence: I want you ___ the truth, whatever it is.
gaps.explanation: want + object + to-infinitive: want you to tell.
seem/appear take the to-infinitive: seems to know.

gaps.sentence: You risk ___ your licence if you drink and drive.
They don't allow ___ in the museum.
gaps.hint: allow + noun / allow sb to do
gaps.explanation: allow + noun/-ing (no personal object): they don't allow photography. With a person: allow visitors to photograph.

gaps.sentence: I tried ___ the shelf up, but it was too heavy.
gaps.explanation: try + to-infinitive = attempt, make an effort.

gaps.sentence: I didn't mean ___ you — it was a joke.
gaps.explanation: mean (= intend) takes the to-infinitive: didn't mean to upset. (mean + -ing = involve.)
